ORDER This is a successive bail petition filed by the petitioner to enlarge him on bail in Crime No.289/2020, registered at Pulakeshi Nagar Police Station, Bengaluru city.

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
2. In the earlier petition, the learned counsel for petitioner after arguing the matter for sometime,
sought permission of the Court to withdraw the petition and the petition was disposed of reserving liberty to the petitioner to move the Sessions Court, after recording the evidence of the victim girl.
3. Today, when the matter is taken up, petitioner's counsel has remained absent.
Copy of the deposition of the victim girl has not been furnished.
However, learned HCGP submits that victim's evidence has been recorded and she has supported the case of Prosecution.

4. This petition is listed today for furnishing of process fee etc., as the same was not furnished inspite of issuance of notice to respondent No.2, specifically observing on the previous date of hearing that if the needful is not done within a week's time, petition shall be dismissed.
5. In view of the above, petition is dismissed.
